activity_summary: Heminges set out six-and-twenty shillings to each sharer, the first share since July. You told Burbage what the Rose yard had been, gilded mail under the June throne, their king all is and yours all seems, five weeks. Heminges named Monday at two as The Shrew. You put the share in your purse and left the coffer at twenty pound fifteen. You said you were for your bed by nine.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Took six-and-twenty into his purse, left the coffer shut, and named nine o'clock.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Told the share, and named Monday at two as The Shrew.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Asked to have his counted twice, and stayed on you.

entities.name: George Bryan
entities.context: Counted the same pile, and went for the gate.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Called it a Saturday, not a fortune.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Asked after the Rose, and named Monday's bill again on the way out.

facets.activity: Took six-and-twenty shillings and named Monday's Shrew

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: Here is the first share since July on the cloth. Count your own: six-and-twenty shillings to each man

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: Monday at two is The Shrew

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I am for my bed by nine tonight, John
